description_target.ambiguity_notes: Unrelated gray cells must remain gray; generated examples need dense gray noise and edge-clipped pluses so global 5->2 and interior-only shortcuts fail.
negative_constraints: do not recolor every gray cell
do not require the plus center to be yellow
do not require a full five-cell footprint at a border
solution_steps: locate the unique clipped or full cardinal-plus footprint containing exactly that yellow component and gray elsewhere
recolor the gray cells in that footprint red
description_target.source: canonical task review 2026-07-23 (parallel reviewer, harvested at intake)
description_target.target_text: Complete each hidden cardinal plus: preserve yellow evidence, recolor only the gray cells missing from that plus red, and leave all distractor gray unchanged.
